# Test parsing an Objective-C class from Apple's documentation
# This test uses NSApplication as an example

env INPUT_DIR=$HOME/.appledocs/cache/developer.apple.com/tutorials/data/documentation

# Parse the class using occ2go command
exec occ2go $INPUT_DIR/AppKit/NSApplication.json
stdout 'type NSApplication struct'
stdout 'NSResponder'
stdout 'TODO: Add fields'
